node.label: Diminished alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: Concentration or activity of the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme is a multienzyme complex consisting of 3 protein subunits, oxoglutarate dehydrogenase, also known as alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase or E1k (EC 1.2.4.2.), dihydrolipoyl succinyltransferase (DLST, or E2k; 126063), and dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (DLD, or E3; 238331). The complex catalyzes a key reaction in the Krebs tricarboxylic acid cycle.
